tokens.faq_1_question: What should I do immediately if my breaker panel starts smoking or sparking?
tokens.faq_1_answer: If it is safe to do so, shut off your main breaker switch immediately, evacuate the area if flames are present, and call our 24/7 emergency dispatch hotline.
tokens.faq_2_question: Why are smoking outlets or buzzing wall switches a major fire hazard?
tokens.faq_2_answer: Buzzing or smoking indicates loose wiring, arcing, or excessive electrical resistance which can quickly ignite wall insulation and framing. Call an electrician right away.
tokens.faq_3_question: Do you charge extra for midnight or weekend emergency electrical calls?
tokens.faq_3_answer: We maintain transparent, flat-rate emergency pricing with no hidden surprises, regardless of whether you call during a holiday freeze or late-night thunderstorm.
tokens.faq_4_question: How fast can an emergency electrician arrive at my home?
tokens.faq_4_answer: Our average on-site emergency response time for hazardous electrical situations is between 25 and 40 minutes.
tokens.faq_5_question: Are your electricians fully licensed and certified?
tokens.faq_5_answer: Every technician on our team is a state-certified licensed master electrician, fully insured, background-checked, and safety-trained.
